text:
Aisha (platform): quick check — I'm planning a cautious canary for the new batch-window-v2 flag that tweaks our batching window heuristics. want to coordinate scope + rollback criteria before I flip it for real.
Tom (runtime): +1. what's the initial scope? route, region, percent?
Aisha (platform): plan: /v1/generate only, EU region (to limit blast radius), 5% traffic. only for hosted API (not dedicated/private). will auto-disable for requests with user.overrides=true.
Diego (sre): good. add guardrail: p95 latency must not regress >30ms vs baseline in the first 10m, and 5xx error rate <= baseline +0.2%. also watch GPU util and queue length.
Aisha (platform): noted. rolling window checks: 5m/10m/30m. if any fails, rollback immediately. also limit max batching delay to 40ms in this flag to avoid tail latency.
Tom (runtime): FYI batch-window-v2 changes KV cache prefetch timing — we should validate end-to-end token throughput. I can attach a test job that sends synthetic traffic matching gen-friendly prompt shapes.
Maya (oncall): I'll be oncall this afternoon. prefer we do the flip in the 14:00-16:00 UTC window. ping me 10m before.
Aisha (platform): schedule: flip to canary 14:30 UTC for 30m observation, then 5% steady for 2h if healthy. target next step 25% Tue morning after validation.
Tom (runtime): PR is up: https://git.internal/redwood/platform/pulls/8145 — contains runtime guard and feature flag hook. please review.
Aisha (platform): FF id: batch-window-v2. internal flag UI: https://flags.redwood/flags/batch-window-v2. curl to toggle (internal API):
```
curl -X POST "https://ff.internal/api/v1/toggles/batch-window-v2" \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FF_TOKEN" \ 
  -d '{"state":"on","conditions":{"percent":5,"routes":["/v1/generate"],"regions":["eu-west-1"]}}'
```
Tom (runtime): I'll add smoke tests to the canary job: call /v1/generate x100, assert p50/p95 and that responses include expected prefix for warmed caches.
Diego (sre): queries to run (Grafana):
- requests_p95{route="/v1/generate",region="eu-west-1"}
- error_rate{job="api",route="/v1/generate"}
- gpu_utilization{pool!="dev"}
Also look at queue_length and batch_size distribution.
Maya (oncall): oncall checklist before flip: confirm dashboards open, alert thresholds armed, slack channel pinned, pager escalation path ready. I will join 14:25 UTC and watch.
Aisha (platform): deploy-bot will log: "deploy-bot: batch-window-v2 set to canary (5%) by aisha" — I'll post here when I flip.
ff-service-bot: feature flag batch-window-v2 canary created (id=ff-3372)
deploy-bot: batch-window-v2 set to canary (5%) by aisha
Tom (runtime): quick code-review ping @Tom — please review the metrics patch in PR 8145, comment left on guardrail thresholds.
Diego (sre): if we need to rollback: a) toggle off via API, b) kill canary instances if any pinned, c) open incident channel and tag oncall. keep rollback <5min target.
Aisha (platform): thanks all. I'll flip at 14:30 and report back with snapshots at +5m, +30m, +2h. :thumbsup:
Maya (oncall): ack, will watch and call if anomalies. :ear:
